pr_title: Fix crash when trying to undo SpriteFrames animation rename
pr_body:
Fixes #93079 
*Bugsquad edit:* Also fixes #92600

The problem was introduced by PR #90815. As suggested by KoBeWi in that PR, I modified the verification to check if the new SpriteFrames is different. I removed the method `is_editing` because I found it redundant with `get_sprite_frames`.

Tested with renaming animations, Ctrl-Z, adding animations, and removing animations.

review_comments:
I don't get the last condition. "if the new SpriteFrames is the same as already edited SpriteFrames then edit them again" is basically what this means, unless I'm missing something.
This could mean that the old reference is not cleared properly and/or the editor tries to edit the same resource twice.

When renaming an animation, the `frames` variable in `frames_editor` is still there with the current SpriteFrames. So the problem was that the previous `is_edited` method was returning true, causing the plugin to close. Maybe `frames` should have been cleared on a rename? The idea here is that if the current editing SpriteFrames is the same as the one received in `p_object`, the plugin should still be opened. I'm not familiar with this part of Godot, feel free to suggest another suggestion, no problem :)

Renaming an animation will update the inspector, which leads to `handles()` + `edit()` and then another `handles()` call. So I guess the original assumption that the editor won't check the same resource twice was wrong. It correctly edits it only once though, so it's fine.
